function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values — rows may not be one-per-entity", "implication": "This is critical: if multiple rows exist per patient, then counting patients by site will over-represent those patients who were re-tested. The data dictionary states that 'A patient who was re-tested appears twice', and 'the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient'. Therefore, to ensure one row per patient, we must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping the row with the highest `sample_seq`. Failure to do so will bias the response rate by over-counting re-tested patients."}
function.name: note_finding
